title: sutera violacea
intro: Sutera violacea, commonly known as Blue Passionflower or Passion Flower, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. The health benefits of Sutera violacea include its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, alleviate symptoms of menopause, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and anxiolytic properties, which work together to promote relaxation and reduce muscle tension. Bioactive constituents of Sutera violacea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, such as harman, apigenin, and vitexin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
